test_title: PYST 42: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 23 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Seven people D, E, F, G, L, M and N are sitting in a row, facing north. Only five people sit between M and L. F sits to the immediate left of L. Only one person sits between F and E. N sits at some place to the left of G but at some place to the right of D. Who sits third from the left end of the row?
solution:
Given: Seven people D, E, F, G, L, M, and N are sitting in a row, facing north.

Only five people sit between M and L.

F sits to the immediate left of L.

Only one person sits between F and E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/818b27d98a1f7435c356be341b9d4420d33eb17f6e9d97c46074547217436078.png] 

N sits at some place to the left of G but at some place to the right of D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c854d4435423bea088d302308e39c88de538b92f96e0b7db2d19235f3c0ea602.png] 

Thus, N sits third from the left end of the row.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
